tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for agreeing to participate. I'd like to ask you some questions about holiday celebrations. First, do you celebrate holidays with your family, friends or both? How often do you participate with them?
tasks.sample: I usually celebrate holidays with both my family and my friends. For example, during Spring Festival, I always spend time with my family at home, having dinner together. But for holidays like New Year’s Eve or Halloween, I like to go out with my friends. I participate in holiday activities quite often — probably a few times each month when there’s a holiday season. It’s a good way to stay connected with people I care about.
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢您同意参与。我想问您几个关于节日庆祝的问题。第一个问题：您是与家人、朋友，还是两者一起庆祝节日？您参与其中的频率是怎样的？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you. Can you describe one of your favorite holiday celebrations or festivals? What do you do to mark the occasion?
tasks.sample: One of my favorite holidays is the Mid-Autumn Festival. On that day, my family and I get together in the evening. We eat mooncakes, drink tea, and enjoy the full moon outside. Sometimes we also light small lanterns. What I love most is the peaceful atmosphere and the feeling of being with my family. It’s simple, but it always makes me feel happy and thankful.
tasks.analysis: 中文：谢谢。您能描述一下您最喜欢的节日或庆典之一吗？您会做些什么来纪念这个时刻？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. Tell me about a special event that was particularly memorable for you. What made it meaningful?
tasks.sample: A memorable event for me was celebrating my grandmother’s 80th birthday during the Spring Festival. All her children and grandchildren came back home — some from very far away. We cooked together, sang songs, and listened to her tell old stories. What made it meaningful was seeing how happy she was. That moment reminded me how important family is and why we should always make time for them.
tasks.analysis: 中文：有意思。请告诉我一个对您来说特别难忘的活动。是什么让它如此有意义？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Great, some people believe that traditional cultural observances are becoming less important in modern society. Do you agree or disagree with this viewpoint? Why?
tasks.sample: I slightly disagree with that viewpoint. I think traditional observances are still important to many people, especially during holidays like Spring Festival or Thanksgiving. However, I do agree that some younger people are less interested in traditions than before. But in my opinion, traditions are not disappearing — they are just changing. People still celebrate, just in simpler or more modern ways. So I believe traditions remain meaningful in today’s society.
tasks.analysis: 中文：很好。有些人认为，在现代社会中，传统文化习俗正变得不那么重要。您同意还是不同意这个观点？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview
